name: devforum-plus
description: A faster, cleaner, more capable devforum.roblox.com.

scripts.prebuild: npm run tokens && npm run icons && npm run rules && npm run check:styles && npm run check:assets
scripts.build: npm run prebuild && wxt build && wxt build -b firefox
scripts.build:firefox: npm run prebuild && wxt build -b firefox
scripts.zip: npm run prebuild && wxt zip && wxt zip -b firefox
scripts.test: tsx tests/unit/detect.test.ts && tsx tests/unit/highlight.test.ts && tsx tests/unit/protocol.test.ts && tsx tests/unit/registry.test.ts && tsx tests/unit/links.test.ts
scripts.check: npm run compile && npm run tokens && npm run check:styles && npm test
